title: UTMB Mont-Blanc — The race
claims: The 2026 UTMB course is listed as 174 kilometres on the official stat block.
The 2026 UTMB course is listed as 9,700 metres of positive elevation gain on the official stat block.
The course passes through Italy, Switzerland and France.
The race starts and finishes in Chamonix.
The official 2026 race page provides a GPX download.
